dante.overview: In Hero Wars: Dominion Era, Dante emerges as one of the most versatile and deadly marksmen in the game. With his agility-based attacks and mid-line positioning, Dante combines speed and power to strike down enemies before they even reach your tanks.

dante.best_allies:
What makes Dante special is that he does not rely on raw stats alone. He pressures multiple enemies with spectral spears, buffs team Dodge, punishes heavy hits with automatic counterattacks, and lowers enemy main stats at the same time. That package gives him damage, disruption, and survivability without needing to play like a standard backline glass cannon. Dependent on Dodge: Dante’s damage and utility heavily rely on successfully dodging attacks, making him less effective against accuracy or control-heavy enemies.
Squishy Without Proper Builds: Without sufficient armor or health, Dante can be fragile and prone to burst damage.
Situational Debuff: The stat reduction from Shackles of Weakness is useful but depends on landing hits from his spears, which can be interrupted. Dante continues to be one of the top damage dealers in Hero Wars, thanks to his high mobility, dodge, and powerful spear throws that hit multiple enemies. The best teams with Dante generally focus on increasing his survivability and amplifying his burst damage. Below are high-level defensive formations that maximize his performance in the arena and guild wars, as well as offensive compositions that make the most of his high damage and agility scaling.
dante.counters: Shackles of Weakness adds a debuff layer to Dante’s spear hits. Whenever a spectral spear from Instrument of Fate or Retribution lands, Dante reduces the enemy’s main stat by 7,022 for 5 seconds. That lowers enemy damage, defense scaling, or healing scaling depending on who gets hit, which gives Dante more value than a pure damage marksman in longer fights. Dante can be a dangerous opponent, but he has clear weaknesses you can exploit with the right heroes and tactics. Because his playstyle depends on dodging physical hits, crowd control abilities and magic damage are particularly effective.

yasmine.counters:
Skills: Yasmine's deadly strikes explained
Learn how Yasmine's abilities work in Hero Wars: Dominion Era and which ones to level up first for maximum efficiency.



Dance of Death

Yasmine paralyzes the last enemy who attacked her for 3 seconds, teleports behind them, strikes 7 times, and applies an Assassin’s Mark. While this skill is active, she cannot receive debuffs. After the attack, she returns to her original position and continues to attack the marked target.
This is Yasmine’s main damage skill and the core of her gameplay. It deals massive single-target damage and makes her untouchable while active.
Damage Formula: 40% Physical Attack + 40 × Level per hit.
Calculated Damage: 0.4 × 89,672 + 40 × 130 = 41,069 damage per hit. Since the skill hits 7 times, the total burst damage is approximately 287,482 before defenses.
Evolution Priority: 1 (Highest) — This skill defines Yasmine’s entire strategy. Upgrading it first greatly increases her burst damage and survivability.





Dance of Death Skill, Hero Wars Dominion Era.





Assassin's Instinct

When Dance of Death is used, Yasmine gains bonus critical hit chance and Dodge for 10 seconds. This makes her harder to hit and increases her chances to land critical hits.
This skill boosts both her offense and defense, especially during her most dangerous moments right after using her ultimate skill.
Effect Formula: 40% Physical Attack + 40 × Level + 500 for bonus Critical Hit Chance and Dodge.
Calculated Bonus: 0.4 × 89,672 + 40 × 130 + 500 = 41,569 bonus Critical Hit Chance and 41,569 bonus Dodge for 10 seconds.
Evolution Priority: 2 — A great follow-up to improve her survivability and ensure more poison stacks through critical hits.








Embrace of Pain

Yasmine’s critical hits poison enemies. If a poisoned enemy is hit again, the poison duration resets and the damage stacks up to 10 times. Each poison effect deals pure damage over time.
This skill adds consistent damage during long fights. The stacking poison can finish off enemies even if they survive her main skill.
Damage Formula: 33% Physical Attack + 30 × Level pure damage per poison stack every 5 seconds.
Calculated Damage: 0.33 × 89,672 + 30 × 130 = 33,492 pure damage per stack every 5 seconds. At 10 stacks, this reaches approximately 334,918 pure damage every 5 seconds before reductions or cleanses.
Evolution Priority: 3 — While strong, it depends heavily on critical hits. Level it after boosting her main attack and crit rate.





Embrace of Pain Skill, Hero Wars Dominion Era.





Unknown Toxin

Enemies poisoned by Yasmine receive less healing. Each time they are healed, a portion of it is blocked based on Yasmine’s stats.
While useful against healing-heavy teams, it is situational and doesn’t directly increase her damage output.
Healing Block Formula: 20% Physical Attack + 30 × Level + 500 blocked healing per heal.
Calculated Effect: 0.2 × 89,672 + 30 × 130 + 500 = 22,334 healing blocked each time a poisoned enemy is healed.
Evolution Priority: 4 (Lowest) — It's helpful in specific fights, but it's the least important for raw damage. Upgrade this last. Amira – Counter Pick

Amira disables Yasmine by making all her critical hits miss for 7 seconds. Since Yasmine’s poison and burst damage rely on landing crits, this completely shuts down her offensive power temporarily. Celeste clears Yasmine’s poison and prevents debuffs with her "Limbo" skill. She keeps the team clean from Yasmine's damage-over-time and healing block effects. Faceless stuns Yasmine with "Power Throw," interrupting her attack sequence. By repositioning her and delaying her damage, your team gains time to respond or eliminate her. Helios retaliates against critical hits with "Flaming Retribution." Since Yasmine heavily depends on crits, she ends up taking severe magic damage every time she strikes, often leading to her own downfall.

His playstyle rewards fast skill rotations and synergy with team-wide buff providers.

fluffy.overview: Wait… is that a soft bleat echoing across the battlefield? Meet Fluffy — an innocent-looking lamb hiding something far more sinister beneath his wool. 🐑🔥
artifacts_priority: Fluffy’s artifacts reinforce her risky demon-support kit in Hero Wars: Dominion Era, adding teamwide magic defense, raw health and scaling damage.
glyphs_priority: Recommended glyph order for Fluffy based on battlefield utility and synergies with her kit.
fluffy.best_allies:
Risk of self-damage: Some counter mechanics (e.g., Usurpation when triggered) inflict self-damage; ensure sufficient HP and sustain.
Vulnerable to magic bursts: Heavy magic damage can outpace heals and bypass the ultimate's protection.
Ability/CD dependency: Usurpation has a cooldown and a chance to cancel—not always reliable.
Positioning is critical: Needs proper placement to take advantage of Readiness and resurrection windows.
Counters: Silences, dispels and skill-level reduction greatly weaken Fluffy.
